column4: >Handcrafted Fluted Amber Glass with Teakwood Lid

column1: The First Burn: Burn uninterrupted for 3 to 4 hours on your first session until the golden liquid pool touches all four glass rims. This programs the memory of the soy wax and prevents tunneling.
Maintenance: Trim wicks to 5mm (1/4 inch) before each lighting. This preserves a whisper-clean, smokeless golden flame and extends candle longevity.

Vessel Rebirth: When 1/2 inch wax remains, pour hot water into the glass. The wax will float to the top and pop out upon cooling. Wash with mild soap and repurpose as an earthen succulent planter or tea light holder.
